written.description: An audit firm's review practice published as plugins: how to approach an unfamiliar codebase, what to look at in it, and how to write up what you found.

alive.last_commit_message:
Add Trailmark taint-trace skill and native analyzer workflow (#502)

* fix(property-based-testing): separate detector diagnostics from verdicts

* fix(writing-lean-proofs): keep self-tests offline

* fix(checks): skip dependency environments during test discovery

* feat(trailmark): add graph evidence for taint models

Use Trailmark graph evidence for existing taint analyzers' source/sink/sanitizer models and supported propagation/type annotations.

Add the staged /trailmark:taint-trace-run workflow, immutable source/model snapshots, native capability probes, and analyzer-attributed reports.

* fix(trailmark): retain CodeQL path alerts and run graph contracts

Resolve path-problem rules through native SARIF metadata and omit telemetry notifications. Install per-suite graph test dependencies in local and CI runners.

Make trailing helper parameters keyword-only, enforce the positional parameter limit, and wrap workflow prompts.

* fix(trailmark): validate language coverage and native trace evidence

Scope component inventories to their language and root, escape target-derived report content, require Joern relay traversal in native capability traces, and align CodeQL finding guidance with rule metadata.

* fix(trailmark): strengthen taint model evidence and startup isolation

* fix(trailmark): isolate evidence snapshots from native discovery

* docs(trailmark): clarify taint contracts and precision diagnostics

* feat(trailmark): support Psalm 7 with version-bound native probes

* fix(trailmark): compare rebound warning locations

Bind warning identity to native source ranges mapped through preserved source snapshots and enclosing declarations. Keep identical sink statements at distinct locations separate, preserve annotation-only line shifts and duplicate records, and count ambiguous matches separately.

* fix(trailmark): rebind declaration ownership across snapshots

* fix(trailmark): match PHP script end boundaries
